name: Format and lint integration
command:
set -e
git diff --name-only -z upstream/main -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.json' '*.yaml' '*.yml' '*.md' | xargs -0 -r ./node_modules/.bin/vp fmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
git diff --name-only -z upstream/main -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' | xargs -0 -r ./node_modules/.bin/vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives
git diff --check
